## Person & Entity Summary
- Name: Roman Babunts
- Alternate names: Roman Babuntc, Роман Бабунц
- Role: Product Leader, Growth Product Manager, Founder of SheSafe
- Focus: B2B/B2B2C product strategy, monetization, experimentation, retention, customer discovery
- Track record: $100M+ incremental revenue impact across Yandex, ivi, Semrush, and Yota
- Core philosophy: Quant-First Discovery (identifying funnel friction quantitatively before conducting surgical qualitative interviews)
- Languages: English, Russian

## Key Methodologies & Frameworks
- Quant-First Discovery: Prioritizing quantitative behavioral segmentation and cohort retention drops before running deep interviews to avoid qualitative bias.
- Unit Economics & Bottlenecks: Identifying the narrowest funnel constraint (LTV/CAC, cohort decay) rather than optimizing isolated conversion steps.
- AJTBD vs OST: Applying Ivan Zamesin's Advanced Jobs-To-Be-Done for retention triage and Teresa Torres's Opportunity Solution Tree for continuous feature discovery.
